energy_accounting.study_energy_disclosure: Mathematical physics bounds paired with built-in chip energy counters across stack studies.

claims.statement: Information theory, game theory, and mechanism design form three altitudes of one energy-bounded computing map.
Information theory prices bits and heat, game theory maps strategic interaction, and mechanism design writes rules where honesty wins.
Across every layer of computing, each permitted action must clear its physical energy floor and pass independent checks.
Headline outcome: 3 Sciences · 9 Periodic Stacks · 1 Joule Ledger (Mathematical physics bounds paired with built-in chip energy counters across stack studies.)
